ledger.contains: MICI release on DE 17 of 2026 at the groundbreaking of a Mercan Group residential project. Already in the tables: 268 certificates / B/.113.6 million (Jul 2025-Jun 2026), 193 / over B/.90.1 million (previous period), real estate 87.3% of certificates. DE 17 amounts already in program_terms from the gazette. Out of scope: the Mercan Group project (48-storey tower, 200 apartments, delivery 2028, Mercan plan of about B/.200 million), which the release does not say is a qualifying project or count of programme investment. Nothing new added. Rules restated from other sources are now recorded from this document too (decision 8).

Undated MICI programme page for DE 722 (titled 'Decreto ejecutivo 722-antes'): purpose, investment forms, minimums ($500,000 free of liens; USD 300,000 real estate under DE 109 of 2022 until 15 Oct 2024; $500,000 securities; USD 750,000 fixed deposit), benefits (permanent residence, filing before entry, approval in 30 working days, SNM special window). All these rules are already in program_terms from the decrees (DE 722, DE 109, DE 193); the 30 working days is a legal maximum, already t-a422c5cd9e. No statistics. Nothing new added. Rules restated from other sources are now recorded from this document too (decision 8).

SNM residence permits 2025 (preliminary to 31 Dec 2025): Cuadro 1 by month, Cuadro 2 by type, Cuadro 3 by sex, Cuadro 4 by category (decided/approved/denied), Cuadro 5 by country (all categories), Cuadro 6 by age and sex, plus charts.
